en.title: Run it yourself: ulams stack up
en.description: A CLI launcher starts the API, admin panel, Studio and learner interface with one command, and writes the passwords to a file.

video.caption: In the clip: the requirements from the docs, ulams 0.2.0, the plan printed by ulams stack up --dry-run (port 8480), and the On-Call academy at the end. The full image download is not shown and the credentials file is not displayed.

pl.title: Uruchom to sam: ulams stack up
pl.description: Launcher CLI uruchamia API, panel administratora, Studio i interfejs ucznia jedną komendą, a hasła zapisuje do pliku.
